title: Modular constructive Lyndon interpolation for nondistributive logics
summary: We establish the Lyndon interpolation property for basic lattice expansion logics (LE-logics) in arbitrary signatures using display calculi. Our approach is constructive, yielding interpolants algorithmically from derivations, and modular, in the sense that interpolation for axiomatic extensions can be obtained by verifying a local interpolation property for the analytic structural rules corresponding to the additional axioms.
